description: This file defines a set of converter classes for converting between Boolean and other data types such as Integer, String, List, and Set within the Apache OFBiz framework. It implements the ConverterLoader interface to load these converters into the framework.

classes.name: BooleanConverters
classes.description: Main class that loads various Boolean conversion classes, implementing ConverterLoader.

classes.name: BooleanToList
classes.description: Converts Boolean to a List of Boolean (singleton).

classes.name: BooleanToSet
classes.description: Converts Boolean to a Set of Boolean (singleton).

classes.name: IntegerToBoolean
classes.description: Converts Integer to Boolean (non-zero -> true, zero -> false).

methods.name: loadConverters
methods.description: Loads contained converters into the framework.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Various convert methods convert between specified types, throwing ConversionException if conversion fails.
